thread:
Maya Thompson: Quick kickoff 1 CloudHarbor marketplace + joint webinar plan. Need: marketplace asset checklist, webinar date/time (APAC-friendly), landing + registration, bench numbers for blog, and inbound lead routing to sales. Proposed dates: webinar Wed 5/21, blog follow-up week after. Thoughts? :calendar:
Ibrahim Khan: Works for me. Can we aim for 9am PST / 5pm SGT (that's 2pm GMT) to hit US & APAC. Also recommend a small paid push ($800) targeted at CloudHarbor audience on their community newsletter.
Riley Park: Ill mock hero and two social variants. ETA Thurs EOD. Need partner logo assets and preferred colors from Samira.
Samira Malik: I have the partner kit but will ask for an SVG and light/dark versions. They also want a short blurb for the marketplace entry (<120 chars). Ill request it today.
Devon Cole: For benchmarks  I can provide p50/p95 latency and cost-per-1k-tokens for the Redwood-optimized config. @Ibrahim can you share the target workload (chat vs. completion) so I pick the right config?
Ibrahim Khan: Priority is chat (multi-turn) with avg 7 messages per session. Also include embedding retrieval flow numbers if simple to add.
listing-bot: :robot_face: Marketplace checklist: short_description, privacy_policy_url, support_contact, screenshots (1200x800), integration_tag, business_category. Missing: screenshots and privacy link.
Maya Thompson: Action owners: Samira (partner ops + assets), Riley (creative), Devon (benchmark numbers), Ibrahim (paid + targeting), Maya (master doc + invites), and listing-bot  keep us honest :pray:.
Riley Park: Quick Q on hero — do we show product UI or partner co-branding? Suggest split-test: UI for technical audience, co-brand for partner channels.
Samira Malik: CloudHarbor prefers co-branding on partner channels but ok with UI shot on our channels. Will confirm.
Devon Cole: Draft bench numbers: p50=120ms, p95=260ms, cost= $0.45 / 1k tokens on the optimized pipeline. Will add embedding retrieval: p95 retrieval+inference = 420ms. Posting full table to the doc.
Ibrahim Khan: Ill create the LinkedIn ad creative brief and allocate $800. Target: CloudHarbor followers + roles: platform, infra, ML eng. Will share targeting later.
Maya Thompson: Landing page snippet (Devon, feel free to tweak):
<form action="https://redwood.com/registrations/cloudharbor" method="POST">
  <input name="email" placeholder="name@company.com" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="cloudharbor_marketplace" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_medium" value="partner_webinar" />
  <button type="submit">Reserve seat</button>
</form>
Maya Thompson: Routing: webhook to /hooks/cloudharbor -> create lead in SFDC with utm_source, utm_campaign, original_referrer, partner_id=cloudharbor. @Devon can we include an event payload example?
Devon Cole: Example payload: {"email":"...","utm_source":"cloudharbor_marketplace","partner_id":"cloudharbor","original_referrer":"..."}  will paste JSON into the doc.
listing-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: privacy_policy_url required for submission. Also screenshots status: pending.
Samira Malik: CloudHarbor will send screenshots by Tue. They'll also co-author the blog and can provide a short quote.
Riley Park: Ill upload hero + social cards to the shared drive and link in the master doc. Prefered file types: SVG + PNG.
Ibrahim Khan: Small note on tracking: use campaign utm_campaign=cloudharbor_may_launch and set lead_source=partner_marketplace in SFDC mapping.
Maya Thompson: Thanks everyone. Target checklist: finalize assets by Fri so we can submit marketplace listing Mon. Ill create the calendar invite and the master Google doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/cloudharbor-marketplace-launch
deploy-bot: :rocket: Created epic MK-4920 and linked the document. Please add task IDs to the doc.
